data.one_liner: A customizable SafeArea widget that lets you set its color without affecting its child.
data.what_it_does: It acts as a replacement for the standard SafeArea widget. It allows developers to specify a background color for the safe area padding, apply blur effects, and manage overflow rules and interactability for children.
use_when: You need to color the safe area padding differently from the app background.
You want to apply a blur effect to the safe area.
You need fine-grained control over child overflow behavior in safe areas.
avoid_when: You only need the standard behavior of the default Flutter SafeArea widget.
strengths: Allows setting safe area color without affecting child color
Supports transparent colors and blur effects via ImageFilter
Provides customizable overflow rules and tappable overflow areas
weaknesses: Not documented for non-standard use cases outside of standard Flutter views
